component.name: Core Terminal
component.summary: A GTK4 terminal with Terminal.app-style profiles and window groups

description.p: Core Terminal is a GTK4 and VTE terminal emulator for Linux. Profiles save terminal appearance and behavior, while window groups reopen ordered tabs with their saved profiles and directories. It also provides keyboard mappings, colors, shell behavior, and import support for selected Terminal profile fields.
Improved Window Group editing and Flatpak host-shell integration.
